verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents an API endpoint for sending or receiving SMS, or SMS delivery-status callbacks. The related items do not show this capability: company-wide blocking of inbound texts is an adjacent control, and the generic webhook listing and websocket event subscriptions are not tied to SMS delivery status. For a cloud communications platform this axis clearly applies, so the lack of evidence makes it "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As a developer, I can send and receive SMS on the number through the API with delivery status callbacks
